The hover pod is drawn in pure front elevation (like an arcade racer front view): a massive 10-row vertical front bumper with headlights/grille (rows 17-26) and a front-facing windshield/canopy (rows 6-12), leaving only a negligible 2-3 pixel rim along the top edge (rows 3-5) where the roof should foreshorten from above.
